answer: I would anchor trust in Container image publish history. With images pushed and pulled for two years, a single thread check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since images pushed and pulled for two years takes calendar time as well as money — and the pulse is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the umber of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
